description: Header file defining the VideoDecodeAccelerator interface and related structures for video decoding support in media components, including configuration, capabilities, error handling, and client callbacks.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Interface for hardware-accelerated video decoding, supporting initialization, decoding, buffer management, and error reporting.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::SupportedProfile
classes.description: Describes a supported decoding profile including profile type, resolution range, and encryption requirement.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the capabilities of a VDA, including supported profiles and feature flags.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for initializing a VDA, including codec profile, encryption, output mode, and color space.

classes.name: VideoDecodeAccelerator::Client
classes.description: Interface for callbacks from the VDA to provide buffers, deliver pictures, and report status/errors.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with specific configuration; returns true if successful.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a bitstream buffer containing at most one frame.

methods.name: AssignPictureBuffers
methods.description: Provides the decoder with picture buffers for output.

methods.name: ImportBufferForPicture
methods.description: Imports a GPU memory buffer as backing memory for a picture buffer.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Releases a picture buffer for reuse.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the decoder, decoding all pending inputs.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder, dropping all pending inputs.

methods.name: SetOverlayInfo
methods.description: Sets an optional graphics surface for rendering.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the decoder and releases resources.

methods.name: TryToSetupDecodeOnSeparateSequence
methods.description: Attempts to set up decoding on a separate sequence/thread.

methods.name: GetSurfaceInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the surface, e.g., BGRA for Windows.

methods.name: SupportsSharedImagePictureBuffers
methods.description: Indicates support for SharedImage backed picture buffers.

methods.name: GetSharedImageTextureAllocationMode
methods.description: Returns the mode for allocating GL textures for shared images.
